Description:
[center][size=5][b]CREDITS:
ORIGINAL CREATOR[/b] IS [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/9019485]KeionDryke [/url]﻿
you can download their mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/467/?tab=description&BH=6]here[/url]﻿, but it hasn't been updated since Nov. 2016[/size]

[size=4]I recently started playing modded Stardew and this was one of the mods I installed.[/size]
[size=3]I noticed there were some minor bugs and decided to fix them myself, then I saw that other people noticed more bugs and tried fixing as many as I could. If you download my version, it has all the fixes you need that I have noticed. If you find any more bugs, post them and I'll try to fix them.  All updates will have all files required, so if you missed an older version, don't worry![/size]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿

[/size][b][size=5]INSTALLATION:[/size][/b]
[size=4]1.) Download one of the two main files[/size]
[size=4]2.) Open and extract the one you want into your "Mods" folder[/size]

[b][size=5]Known Bugs:
[/size][/b][size=4]1. Dialogue from villagers telling you what other villagers like or love [i]may[/i] say the wrong name, this is due to Stardew pulling internal names instead of display names for people who play in English. [/size]
[i][size=3]*Pathos has added it to the modding wishlist meaning it could get fixed in a future version of SDV[/size][/i]
